course_outline_concepts: SCoRe (Kumar 2024): self-correction as an RL target
ReST-EM + rest of expectation-maximisation self-training line
R1-Zero's emergent reasoning: what really happens in pure-RL and what the 2025 analyses settled

sources.what_to_extract: Iterative DPO loop: sample 4 at T=0.7 top-p=0.9 -> judge with 5-pt rubric averaged over 3 judge samples -> DPO beta=0.1 from prior iterate; Llama-2-70B AlpacaEval 9.94 -> 15.38 -> 20.44 -> 20.8; judge Spearman 0.62 -> 0.71; cap at 3 iterations because iter 4 regresses.

Three-role loop Actor/Judge/Meta-Judge; K=7 actor responses, N=11 judge responses, meta-judge pairwise; actor-DPO + judge-DPO both fed per iteration; Llama-3-8B-Instruct 22.9 -> 39.4 AlpacaEval LC across 4 iters; length-bias control term prevents 2x length inflation.

SPIN closed-form DPO-equivalent: L_SPIN = -log sigmoid(beta*(log pi(y_human)/pi_{t-1}(y_human) - log pi(y_gen)/pi_{t-1}(y_gen))); Nash equilibrium when pi_t = data distribution; UltraChat-200K only, MT-Bench 6.39 -> 7.12 over 3 iterations; reset reference to pi_{t-1} each iter.

Nash-MD update pi_{t+1} prop to pi_ref * exp(eta * E_{y' ~ pi_t} p(.>y'|x)); symmetric equilibrium policy satisfies P(pi* > pi) >= 1/2; Nash-MD-PG via REINFORCE against EMA opponent; motivation: non-transitive preferences where argmax-RM fails.

SCoRe two-stage: Stage I RL on turn-2 only with KL on turn-1 to freeze first attempt; Stage II joint RL with reward shaping [r(y1) + alpha*(r(y2)-r(y1))], alpha=2.0; +15.6 pts MATH, +9.1 pts MBPP; on-policy requirement; SFT on correction traces collapses to mode-1 answer.

EM formulation with latent rationale; E-step K=32 samples T=1.0 top-p=0.95 filtered by exact-match/unit-test; M-step SFT 1 epoch lr=1e-5; MATH 34.1 -> 50.6 over 2 iters on PaLM-2-L, APPS 16.4 -> 31.2; iter-3 regresses without diversity cap (top-4 distinct solutions/problem); BBH transfer gains.

STaR loop: few-shot -> generate rationale+answer -> keep correct -> rationalize-backward from gold answer on failures -> SFT on accepted traces -> repeat; answer-checkable tasks become rationale-learning tasks; precursor to ReST-EM which removes rationalization and scales K.

V-STaR uses failed traces as verifier-training data (classification/preference) + reasoner bootstrap; inference-time selection via verifier; weak verifier reinforces wrong traces failure mode; sibling to ReST-EM in EM family.

R1-Zero: pure GRPO from V3-Base, rule reward = r_acc (exact-match/unit-test) + r_format (<think>...</think><answer>...</answer>); no SFT, no PRM, no value model; group size 16-64, context up to 32k; response length grows 400 -> 10k+ tokens; AIME pass@1 15% -> 70%; aha moment phase transition; language-mixing fix via consistency reward in R1.

Dr.GRPO (Liu 2025) removes std normalization and switches aggregation to batch-mean / (B * L_max); identifies GRPO length bias + difficulty bias; ORZ confirms emergence disappears if base is not reasoning-pretrained; asymmetric clipping eps_high=0.28 stabilizes; TinyZero reproduces at 1.5B on ~$30 budget; all confirm no PRM needed; reasoning prior in base is the load-bearing ingredient.

Yue et al. 2025 pass@k critique: RL improves pass@1 but base model wins at large k; RLVR as sampling-efficiency improvement, not capability-boundary expansion; distillation as cleaner route for new capabilities; recurring across math / code / visual reasoning.

Llama-2 RSFT: 5 rounds of K=10 sample, top-1 by RM, SFT 1 epoch, then PPO; Tulu 3 three-stage SFT -> DPO -> RLVR with reference resets between stages; iteration > single-pass by 3-5 pts; reference reset is load-bearing.

Test-time compute as second scaling axis; reasoning-RL unlocks CoT causal use; open question flagged: how much of R1 is new capability vs elicited from base; CoT-as-interpretability fragility under latent-thought training.
